lyrics:
Lyrics by Kay Uwe Rott "Forever for Me" I would wish for a thousand wings, To paint the air with silver strings. Then I’d see them gently fall, A shining cloak to crown you all. So, I dream of you this way, So, I see the night turn day. When the music starts to rise, You will reign before all eyes. Every soul will stand in awe, As they watch the queen I saw. In my gaze you’ll always stay, Brighter than the sun in May. Endless flames within my heart, An eternal fire, never torn apart. When I think of what will be, You are evermore for me.
